author: Tampa Bay Times
title: Is this the Rapture? | Column - NewsBreak
text:
10 hours ago Is the potential Fujiwhara effect, a rare phenomenon that happens when two storms interact, actually the end of days? [ National Hurricane Center ] To be crystal clear, there is no reason to panic. Do not freak out! Stay calm and level-headed in the face of all alarming tropical weather developments. Be the straight-A student of commonsense hurricane preparation Florida has taught you to be.
However, uh. I have a couple questions, private, deep-seated inquiries of the soul I will confess to absolutely no one except all of you:
Is this the Rapture?
Were the skeptics wrong? Has the frenzied corner of the internet calling for a ceremonial, late-September sky suckage of true believers been correct this entire time?
Will the world be taken out by a... double hurricane ?
What I mean is, should I get my affairs in order?
Will the seven-year period of tribulation be ushered in via the Fujiwhara effect , a rare phenomenon that happens when two storms interact? Will the Feast of Trumpets masquerade as Invest 93L and Invest94L making howling noises just outside the ancient windows we have been meaning to replace?
If said disturbances do materialize into named storms, will legions of scoffers be left behind by Humberto and Imelda? Shouldn’t the names be more threatening?
Am I going to have to learn about vortices in the last days?
Is there anything we can do to pull these wily kids off of each other? Like, does anyone know any incantations? Or is one of you just really talented at defusing a tense situation, like when the grown cousins start arguing about cancel culture at Thanksgiving? Maybe we can talk them down?
Would a double hurricane actually be kind of metal?
Do I have a death wish?
Can my dog come? I’m kind of mad at him right now because he broke into a pack of mini muffins, but I’m not so upset that I want him to wander eternally among lost heathen souls, you know?
Do I need to wear something specific? Should I shower first? If and when the Fujiwhara effect releases us from our earthly vessels, is there a dress code? Is being raptured like being in a traffic accident while wearing embarrassing underwear just like our mothers warned?
Alternatively, if and when we are left to toil on the wasted remains of the planet, will we keep having hurricanes? Or can we finally stop buying flats of Chef Boyardee and Kirkland water and D batteries? Will the double hurricane be the last hurricane? Will we be subject to a rise of lawlessness in the streets but freed from the shackles of boarding up windows and evacuating to Red Roof Inns in West Palm Beach at 2 a.m.?
Will the tradeoff be a little worth it?
